description.zh: 是否需要自动旋转功能（结构化检测、混贴场景、教育相关场景会自动做旋转，无需设置），返回角度信息
description.en: Specifies whether to enable automatic rotation. Rotation is automatically applied in structured detection, mixed-layout scenarios, and education-related scenarios, so you do not need to set this parameter in those cases. The rotation angle is included in the response.

description.zh: 是否输出单字识别结果
description.en: Specifies whether to output per-character recognition results

description.zh: 是否输出表格识别结果，包含单元格信息
description.en: Specifies whether to output table recognition results, including cell information

description.zh: 图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
description.en: Image URL (must be no longer than 2048 bytes; Base64 encoding is not supported)

description.zh: 图片二进制文件，最大10MB，与URL二选一。 使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body 中上传即可。 使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
description.en: Binary image file, up to 10 MB in size. You must specify either this parameter or the URL parameter. To use HTTP invocation, place the binary image file in the HTTP body. To use the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.
